description: Patronus checks user-prompt and tool/MCP-result text before model delivery. PreToolUse attributes Patronus operations to this chat; SessionStart validates lifecycle input and reads settings; Stop releases the turn's private runtime state. Ordinary tool arguments and media bytes are never scanned.
